Messages.Author: Matt Bell
Messages.Body:
Just a question about this one, it says
Call a vote, the next vote automatically passes.

But it doesn't say the next vote by you, does this mean that if I do a
charming lobby but don't call another vote that who ever calls the next
vote gets an automatic pass?

TIA
Matt Bell

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


That is correct. Also true if you try to call another vote, but get blocked.

Note that Blood Hunt votes don't qualify. [TOM 21-SEP-95]
